name: City Hall
summary: Civic and arts core on NSL/EWL — Padang-adjacent condo and hotel-serviced edges with walkable museums and CBD hops.
body: City Hall is the shortlist when civic-core walkability and dual-line interchange access matter more than quiet heartland texture. The pocket sits on the Padang / museum / theatre belt with condo and serviced-apartment edges rather than HDB grids. Expats land here for car-light CBD and arts nights without full Orchard tourist crush. Watch-outs: event-day closures, tourist footfall, serviced-vs-TA confusion, and dense-building refuse / visitor-app variance. Compare with Bras Basah for arts-school energy, Marina Bay for skyline premiums, and Mattar when you want quieter mid-town nights.
bestFor: renters comparing serviced vs proper TA nearby
people who will book ActiveSG niche sports instead of trusting condo amenities
watchOuts: Tourist footfall on Padang event days
Refuse / bulky rules vary sharply by building
housingMix: Condo and serviced-apartment stock with limited HDB texture.
commuteNotes: North-South and East-West Lines at City Hall; walkable to Esplanade / Padang belt. Test a National Day rehearsal week before you romanticise quiet.
